text:
If you've got outdoor plans today, keep them loose, since another round of showers and storms rolls through this afternoon. NWS has the numbers at 40 percent, but the European model is much wetter, near 90, while the other guidance is closer to that official call. I'd bet on scattered rather than soggy, but a stronger storm or two with gusty wins and maybe some small hail isn't out of the question, so keep an eye on the sky if you're out and about. High near 78 under mostly cloudy skies, with the best chance for wet weather arriving midday into the afternoon and wrapping up by evening. The lake's a mixed bag too, southwest winds under 10 knots early switching to a brisker northwest 10 to 15 later, so if you're getting out on the water, earlier is calmer.

Friday flips the script completely: sunny, dry, high near 78, with north winds keeping things fresh. Good waterfront morning today if you get out before early afternoon; after that, I'd have a rain plan ready and save the long outdoor stuff for tomorrow.
